headline: Clash of Clans: the Liam Neeson ad
title: Clash of Clans Super Bowl Ad With Liam Neeson | Supercell Facts | Classic Games
video_script: Clash of Clans comes from Supercell, a studio based in Helsinki, Finland. It came out on iOS on August second, twenty twelve, and on Android on October seventh, twenty thirteen. In February twenty fifteen, Supercell ran a Super Bowl ad where Liam Neeson parodies his Taken role, furious that his village got raided. YouTube viewers ranked it the second best ad of that Super Bowl. Which Town Hall are you? Comment below!
description: Clash of Clans by Supercell (Finland) launched on iOS on August 2, 2012 and Android on October 7, 2013. Its Super Bowl XLIX ad with Liam Neeson aired in February 2015 and YouTube viewers voted it the second best ad of the game.
